dimensions.assessment: Affects disaster survivors, emergency management personnel, FEMA employees, and local anti-violence service providers.
dimensions.evidence: ensure that all employees of the Agency shall be trained on how to identify, care for, and refer victims and survivors of gender-based violence

dimensions.assessment: Modifies post-disaster operational procedures, sheltering protocols, reporting mechanisms, and staff training requirements to protect vulnerable survivors.
dimensions.evidence: issue such regulations and guidance as are necessary to prevent gender-based violence, human trafficking, and sexual exploitation after a disaster.

dimensions.assessment: Requires FEMA to determine eligible expense reimbursements and carry out training, but specifies that it is subject to the availability of appropriations without setting a new spending total.
dimensions.evidence: This Act shall be carried out subject to the availability of appropriations.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act and mandates broad agency-wide regulatory, guidance, and training changes.
dimensions.evidence: To direct the Administrator of the Federal Emergency Management Agency to issue guidance and regulations relating to preventing gender-based violence, human trafficking, and sexual exploitation

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendments to disaster relief laws and ongoing agency operational requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Administrator... shall issue such regulations and guidance

missing_information: Specific funding authorization amounts or figures for implementing the training and new sheltering protocols are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs FEMA to issue regulations and guidance aimed at preventing gender-based violence, sexual exploitation, and human trafficking following disasters, and mandates training for FEMA employees.
